limitations: Evidence class: numerical verification on ref-x86-64 (TRS2): analytic mpmath expectations (G7-G10) and independent hand models over certified production re-solves (G19, G20). Not empirical validation, and not optimality evidence: KKT_POINT_VERIFIED is numerically verified local stationarity of the held-regime problem; second-order conditions are not assessed.

Status implemented, not tested: the D-61 description reviews are open (OPT.D61 fails), so the full gate (G21) cannot pass at this commit; G21 and the aarch64 half of G13 are not confirmed by the build lane.

Optimising needs the audited nlp environment on linux-x86_64 and the revision_eo route; elsewhere validate/submit_job are unsupported (nlp_solver_unavailable), and coupled or legacy_eo documents are UNSUPPORTED (OPTIMIZATION_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE). Phase and assessment regimes are held per start; two-phase-side and unguarded-regime boundary optima and the rank-limited-but-inactive gap are NOT_VERIFIED; the zero subsystem is all or nothing per start (design section 9.7).

Robustness (D-70): with Ipopt's fixed options (monotone barrier, limited-memory Hessian) OPT-L stalls at max_iter from the feasible side (673.15 K, 661 K; also with other scales) and verifies from 650 K; G20's request starts there. Such starts are reported SOLVER_FAILED, never verified.
G12 masks the wall-clock members of the record (D-63); D-58 (Q26 allow-list), D-60 (resolver) and D-61 await the design-lane review.
